templates.name: outline
templates.note: Outline needs an authentication provider to sign in: either fill in the SMTP fields above for email (magic-link) sign-in, or add an OIDC/Google/Slack provider by editing the stack. Generate SECRET_KEY and UTILS_SECRET with 'openssl rand -hex 32'. Uploads are stored on a local volume (no S3/MinIO required).

templates.description: Collaboration suite, encrypted and open-source. Source: https://github.com/cryptpad/cryptpad

env.label: Main domain (full URL) — your public CryptPad address
env.name: CPAD_MAIN_DOMAIN

env.label: Sandbox domain (full URL) — MUST be a DIFFERENT origin from the main domain
env.name: CPAD_SANDBOX_DOMAIN

templates.name: cryptpad
templates.note: CryptPad requires two DIFFERENT domains/origins (main + sandbox) fronted by a reverse proxy that forwards to port 3000 — mandatory for its XSS sandboxing. Set both to real, distinct domains before deploying.

templates.description: Static, config-driven link-in-bio page. Profile card, tappable links, vCard download, QR share — all driven from a single YAML file baked at build time. Source: https://github.com/kartikeychoudhary/Reach-me-out
templates.name: reach-me-out
templates.note: Mount your own config.yaml to /usr/share/nginx/html/config.yaml (read-only) to customize name, links and theme. See https://github.com/kartikeychoudhary/Reach-me-out for the YAML schema and examples.
templates.title: Reach Me Out

templates.description: Open-source fuel and EV route planner with real-time prices across 36 countries. Source: https://github.com/GeiserX/Pumperly

env.label: Default country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for the initial map view
env.name: PUMPERLY_DEFAULT_COUNTRY

templates.name: pumperly
templates.note: Fuel prices for the default country work out of the box. Route planning and address autocomplete are DISABLED unless you add external VALHALLA_URL (routing) and PHOTON_URL (geocoding) services by editing the stack; EV charging data needs an OpenChargeMap key (PUMPERLY_OCM_API_KEY).
templates.title: Pumperly

templates.description: Open-source equipment rental platform. Rent out cameras, tools, bikes, party gear or vehicles from a branded storefront with live availability, and manage products, reservations, pickups and returns, customers, PDF contracts and revenue statistics from one dashboard. The storefront is served at the root of the site, the dashboard under /dashboard, and the app installs its own database schema on first boot. Source: https://github.com/Synapsr/Louez

env.label: Public URL of your instance, sign-in is bound to it
env.name: APP_URL

env.label: Host port mapped to the app
env.name: LOUEZ_PORT

env.label: MySQL password for the louez user, set one before first boot
env.name: DB_PASSWORD

env.label: MySQL root password, set one before first boot
env.name: DB_ROOT_PASSWORD

env.label: Image store password, set one before first boot
env.name: MINIO_PASSWORD

templates.name: louez
templates.note: Deploys the app, MySQL and a private MinIO bucket for product images. The first account you create becomes the store owner. Outgoing email is optional: without SMTP credentials you sign in with a password.
templates.title: Louez
